JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id
WHERE m.stage = 'Group'
  AND m.team1 = 'South Africa' OR m.team2 = 'South Africa'
  AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL
  AND d.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field')
  AND d.innings IN (1, 2)
GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY wickets DESC
LIMIT 1;
